text:
Aisha (Marketing): Quick sync — finalizing run-of-show for next Wed's 30-min micro-webinar. We need: 1) tight abstract, 2) confirmed speaker order, 3) rehearsal slot, 4) demo fallback plan. Who can do a last pass today?
Tom (Events): I can take speaker timing and stage ops. Can we keep it 30m strict? Audience expects short + Q. :stopwatch:
Priya (Content): I'll tighten the abstract and craft 3 variant intros (technical, product, business) — which audience are we prioritizing?
Marcus (Demand): Prioritize PM/engineering. The invite list is mostly product engineers from fintech and marketplaces. Also want a short benchmark narrative slide to drive demos.
Elliot (Product): Agree with Marcus. For the demo: plan A = hosted Redwood API live demo, plan B = prerecorded clip + local fallback (to avoid auth flakiness). I can run the prerecorded clip.
Aisha (Marketing): Perfect. Let's lock speaker order: 1) Priya intro (3m), 2) Elliot demo (10m), 3) Marcus customer angle + benchmarks (7m), 4) Q&A (10m). Can everyone confirm?
Tom (Events): Confirmed. I'll own backstage cueing and countdowns. Need rehearsal 1:30pm PT Tuesday — 60m.
Priya (Content): Confirmed. I'll send updated abstracts after this thread. Also crafting two single-sentence headlines for the registration page.
Marcus (Demand): Confirmed. I'll prepare a 1-slide benchmark narrative: latency/cost comparisons, one real customer stat, and the call-to-action.
Elliot (Product): Confirmed. For demo fallback details: local fallback uses a pinned model, lower concurrency. I recommend we script a 60s recorded segment that shows the same prompts.
Aisha (Marketing): Ok draft run-of-show below — please call out edits inline.
Aisha (Marketing): ```run-of-show
00:00 - 00:30 : Welcome & housekeeping (Priya)
00:30 - 03:30 : Abstract + TL;DR (Priya)
03:30 - 13:30 : Live demo (Elliot) — Plan A live hosted API, Plan B recorded clip
13:30 - 20:30 : Benchmark narrative + customer example (Marcus)
20:30 - 30:00 : Live Q&A (all) + CTA + recording info
```
Tom (Events): Small tweak — add a 30s handoff buffer between demo and benchmarks for mic checks.
Aisha (Marketing): Good call. I'll insert a 00:30 buffer after demo.
Priya (Content): For the abstract variants — here's the product-focused one (short): "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower per-token cost — real-world patterns from infra to rollout." Thoughts?
Marcus (Demand): Love it. Maybe add "+ how to avoid surprise costs during scale" as a teaser line.
Elliot (Product): Also: add a tiny visual callout on slide 4 that shows automatic fallbacks (model variants/region routing) — technical folks love architecture diagrams.
Aisha (Marketing): Rehearsal checklist: 1) join 15m early, 2) confirm mic and camera, 3) show prerecord clip works offline, 4) slides uploaded to host, 5) shared script for handoffs. Everyone ok?
Tom (Events): I'll stub calendar invites and set rehearsal to 1:30pm PT Tue. calendar-bot: "Event created: Micro-webinar Rehearsal — Tue 1:30pm PT"
Priya (Content): I'll post the updated abstracts in the doc and put the registration copy variants in the same doc.
Marcus (Demand): Routing plan for leads: primary flow -> demo signups list; fallback -> register interest form + nurture. We'll add UTM params and an embedded benchmark PDF on the thank-you page.
Elliot (Product): One technical triage note: we'll include a single-line operator command to flip to prerecorded demo if hosted API shows >=5% error rate in first 2 minutes. Scripted: `if error_rate > 0.05: switch-demo prerecorded.mp4`
Aisha (Marketing): Love the triage script. Add it to the backstage cue doc and make Tom the exec on switch.
Tom (Events): Ack — I'll be the switch. Also prepping a short fallback line for the MC: "We're switching to a recorded demo to make sure you see the full flow — we'll be back live shortly."
Priya (Content): Anything else for audience Q? Maybe a quick poll during Q&A asking: "What's your top LLM serving pain?" with 4 options.
Marcus (Demand): Yes — that'll feed SDR follow-ups. I'll own poll + follow-up segments.
Aisha (Marketing): Great. Action items: Priya — abstracts + registration copy by EOD. Elliot — prerecorded demo clip + checklist by EOD. Marcus — benchmark slide + thank-you PDF by EOD. Tom — calendar invites + backstage doc by EOD. I'll consolidate and run a 15m dry-run Tue 1:15pm PT.
calendar-bot: "Reminder set: Dry-run 15m before rehearsal — Tue 1:15pm PT"
Elliot (Product): One last note — please confirm model names aren't in slides (use friendly labels) to avoid premature comparisons.
Aisha (Marketing): Noted. We'll use labels like "Model A (low-latency)". Thanks team — feels good. :rocket:
